characters.name: Host
characters.personality: skeptical, observant, dry humor; challenges weak explanations and delivers the grounded perspective
characters.visual_description: Recurring 2D cartoon host with a slim angular silhouette, swept charcoal hair with a small teal streak, warm tan skin, teal jacket over a cream shirt, charcoal trousers and light sneakers. Keep the narrow face, asymmetric jacket and teal accent identical across thumbnails.
characters.thumbnail_traits: Sharp swept-hair silhouette, teal jacket, skeptical eyebrow acting and big readable surprise reactions. Usually the grounded/reactive anchor of the composition.
characters.worldview: Evidence first. Obvious explanations are only provisional until they survive a concrete counterexample.
characters.comic_style: Dry understatement, precise reversals and calmly exposing contradictions; never performs random jokes.
characters.speech_rhythm: Compact and measured. Often answers with a pointed question, then one concrete causal sentence.
characters.strength: Notices hidden assumptions and connects a demonstration back to the viewer's real decision.
characters.blind_spot: Can become overconfident in being the skeptic and occasionally misses the emotional reason a misconception feels persuasive.
characters.scene_drive: Wants the explanation to survive a real test, not merely sound clever.
characters.relationship_dynamic: Respects Buddy's instincts and never treats him as stupid. Pushes his guesses until they become precise; Buddy's emotional honesty stops Host becoming a lecturer.

characters.name: Buddy
characters.personality: curious, energetic, emotionally transparent; asks the obvious question the viewer is thinking and creates reaction beats
characters.visual_description: Recurring 2D cartoon buddy with a broad round silhouette, oversized dark-brown curly hair, warm brown skin, mustard hoodie, blue-gray trousers and dark shoes. Keep the round face, large hair mass and mustard hoodie identical across thumbnails.
characters.thumbnail_traits: Large curly-hair silhouette, mustard hoodie and open energetic reactions. Should contrast immediately with the slim teal host even at tiny thumbnail size.
characters.worldview: Starts from ordinary experience and trusts the answer that feels intuitive until the visible result forces a rethink.
characters.comic_style: Earnest literalism, emotionally honest reactions and playful resistance; humor comes from commitment to a plausible guess.
characters.speech_rhythm: Quick, conversational and interruptible. Uses fragments, concrete examples and candid admissions more than polished explanations.
characters.strength: Voices the exact confusion or objection a smart viewer is likely withholding.
characters.blind_spot: Commits too quickly to the first intuitive model and sometimes protects it with a funny excuse.
characters.scene_drive: Wants an answer usable in real life and keeps asking until the mechanism predicts what happens next.
characters.relationship_dynamic: Challenges Host whenever an explanation sounds abstract. Learns without becoming the permanent student and sometimes reaches the key implication first.
